title: Cycles of Matter
summary: The water, carbon, nitrogen and oxygen cycles, and how human activity is changing them.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 13: Earth as a System: Energy, Matter and Life

objectives: I can describe the water, carbon, nitrogen and oxygen cycles.
I can explain the role of living things in the cycles.
I can explain how humans are changing the carbon and nitrogen cycles.
misconceptions: Plants get their carbon from the soil.
Animals can use nitrogen gas from the air.
Matter is used up by living things.
